metaTitle: CODM Profile & Rank Command for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Show your Call of Duty: Mobile Global level, Multiplayer rank and rating with !codm in Twitch chat. Set a CODM UID or use an exact nickname.
title: Your CODM profile in Twitch chat.
lead: Viewers type !codm for your Call of Duty: Mobile Global level, Multiplayer rank and rating. Enable the free module and enter your UID or exact nickname. Viewers can also type !codm iFerg to check another profile.
howTitle: Link your CODM account and try !codm.
step1Desc: Switch on CODM Profile in the dashboard and enter your Global UID or exact nickname as the default player. If you leave it blank, chat must include one after !codm.
step2Desc: Anyone can type !codm in chat. The bot replies with your level, Multiplayer rank, rating and country.
step3Desc: Edit the profile message template in the dashboard to choose what chat sees. You can switch the profile reply off there too.
listTitle: UID, nickname and what it shows.
item1Desc: Use your CODM Global UID for the lookup, or enter your nickname exactly as it appears in game.
item2Desc: Viewers can check another profile with !codm iFerg or !codm followed by a UID. You can restrict lookups to your linked account in the dashboard.
item3Desc: The module supports CODM Global profiles and returns level, Multiplayer rank and rating, and country.
item4Desc: !codmprofile and !codmrank return the same profile as !codm. Add the short ID to the message template if you want chat to see it.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. The command has a 10 second cooldown.
faqQ1: How do I show my CODM stats in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable CODM Profile in the ItsBagelBot dashboard and enter your Global UID or exact nickname. Viewers can then type !codm for your level, Multiplayer rank and rating. If no account is linked, they must include a UID or nickname.
faqQ2: Does it show my K/D or match history?
faqA2: The reply covers your Global profile: level, Multiplayer rank and rating, country and an optional short ID. It does not include K/D, match history or Battle Royale stats.
faqQ3: Do I need my UID, or does my nickname work?
faqA3: Either works. Enter your CODM Global UID, or use your exact in-game nickname. Save it as the default player in the dashboard or type it after !codm in chat.
faqQ4: Does it work for all CODM editions?
faqA4: It supports the CODM Global edition. Other editions are not supported.
faqA5: Yes. CODM Profile is included in the free plan, and the command has a 10 second cooldown.

tblNote: The reply uses the default template with sample values. Real numbers come from each player's CODM Global profile.
prereq1: Enable CODM Profile in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: A CODM Global UID or exact nickname, saved in the dashboard or typed after !codm.
